turns.excerpt: # Interconnection procedure note ## 1. Deemed Withdrawal of the Interconnection Request If the Interconnection Customer (IC) fails to respond to MISO’s restudy notice within five (5) Business Days, MISO shall deem the interconnection request (IR) withdrawn (BPM-015 r33 §5.4.6).
